name: gini-manufacturing-app
description: GiNi manufacturing demonstration: operator app (frontend/), supervisor/admin app (admin/), Express API + Python engine (backend/). Synthetic data; not a Siemens system. The three packages are independent (no npm workspaces) so each Vercel project installs only its own folder.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix admin
